guide.summary: Two round pools in gel, one fresh and one salty, joined by a narrow channel.
guide.biology: Where fresh and salty water meet through a narrow passage, salt spreads slowly and each side keeps its own character for a long time.
guide.rules: Gel everywhere except two water circles of radius 18 at (40,64) and (88,64), joined by a water channel from x 40 to 88 and y 62 to 65. Salinity 0.6 in the right circle (including the channel cells inside it) and 0 elsewhere. Light 0.8, warmth 0.5, oxygen 0.8, carbon dioxide 0.5, nutrient 0.10 and sugar 0.02 in every cell. Lid open; fixed light.
guide.example: Watch how far the salt creeps along the channel toward the fresh pool.
